records.name: Blackwood Forest
records.description:
This trail leads through a dark forest, thick with trees and brush.
Snow weighs down the branches and occasionally falls in clumps to the
ground as the wind shifts. There is an abnormal chill that reaches

heard the faint sounds of water lapping against land, indicating the
possibility of a large body of water in that direction.

records.name: Scorching Desert
records.description:
White sand dunes sprawl off in all directions here, making navigation
confusing as there are no clear paths or identifiable markers. The
heat here is intense, and when combined with the occasional harsh
bursts of wind, parches the throat and sears the skin. Hanging
overhead is the sun, watching the suffering beings below with a cruel
eye. The unprepared do not survive long in this unforgiving wasteland.
